The Price of the Unexamined Interface

Checking a software handoff is cheap, skipping it destroys spacecraft, and public-good economics explains why teams still skip it.

[$327.6M Mars Loss vs Cheap Automated Handoff Checks]

1/3 Single handoff failures carry exact price tags, like losing a $328M Mars mission over mismatched force units.

2/3 Trillion-dollar national figures come from broad surveys and models of software quality, and none isolates handoff failures alone.

3/3 Checking shared assumptions upfront is cheap, yet teams skip it because one group pays while everyone downstream benefits.
